title: Rav Idi bar Shishi

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 106a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.106a.4); Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 106a has Rav Idi bar Shisha (בר שישא). Hyman’s heading has bar Shishi (בר שישי), and he reports the reversed chain Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi from Dikdukei Soferim.

The linked passage names Rav Idi bar Shisha as particular about a blemished cup. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=407&lang=en) lists him under that same form. Hyman’s heading has Shishi and he attributes the reversed patronymic, Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi, to Dikdukei Soferim.
